description: Data host: block paths outside /datasets/, /query/, /qc/ with .js or .pdf and the pinned /hypomap/ atlas files
expression: (http.host eq "data.hypoexplorer.com" and (not (((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/datasets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/query/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/qc/")) and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pdf"))) or (http.request.uri.path in {"/hypomap/hypomap-atlas-2026-11-05/manifest.json" "/hypomap/hypomap-atlas-2026-11-05/metadata.json.gz" "/hypomap/hypomap-atlas-2026-11-05/search-index.json.gz"} or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/hypomap/hypomap-atlas-2026-11-05/genes-") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json.gz") and len(http.request.uri.path) eq 52))) or http.request.uri.path contains ".." or http.request.uri.path contains "//" or len(http.request.uri.path) gt 256))
